Common questions

### Google Shopping Ads questions, answered

Merchant Center, feeds, budgets and reporting. If yours is not here, ask me on the call.

#### What are Google Shopping Ads?

Google Shopping Ads are product ads that appear in Google search with an image, price and store name. They help online stores reach shoppers who are ready to buy.

#### What is Google Merchant Center?

Google Merchant Center is the tool that stores all your product information, like titles, prices and images. Google reads this to decide when and where to show your Shopping Ads.

#### Do I need a product feed?

Yes. The product feed is the file that lists all your products and their details. It is the engine behind Shopping Ads, and I set it up and optimize it for you.

#### How are Shopping Ads different from Search Ads?

Search Ads are text ads that use keywords. Shopping Ads use your product feed and show an image and price. Shopping is usually better for selling products, while Search is better for services.

#### How much budget do I need for Shopping Ads?

It depends on your products and competition. Some stores start small and scale up once we find winning products. On our call I will suggest a realistic starting budget.

#### Why is the product feed so important?

Google uses your feed to decide which searches show your products. Clear titles and good images bring better placement and cheaper sales, while a weak feed holds your account back.

#### What is the difference between Standard Shopping and Performance Max?

Standard Shopping gives you more control over products and bids. Performance Max is a smart campaign that reaches across all of Google from one setup. I choose the right mix for your goals.

#### How soon will I see results?

Shopping Ads can bring traffic and sales within the first few days. The first few weeks are used to gather data and cut waste, so strong results usually build from the first month.

#### Can you fix my disapproved products?

Yes. Product disapprovals are common and can quietly kill your sales. I find the cause, fix the feed or settings and get your products approved and selling again.

#### Do you optimize my product titles and images?

Yes. I improve your titles, product types and image quality inside the feed, because these directly affect which searches show your products and how many people click.

#### What is ROAS for Shopping Ads?

ROAS, or return on ad spend, tells you how much revenue you earn for every rupee spent. For Shopping, a strong ROAS is one of the clearest signs your store is growing profitably.

#### Can you handle a store with many products?

Yes. I structure large catalogs in a smart way so we can control spend and push budget to your best sellers, even with hundreds of products.

#### Do you work with Shopify and WooCommerce stores?

Yes. I work with Shopify, WooCommerce and other platforms, and I can connect your store to Merchant Center using the right feed method.

#### What reports will I get?

You get clear monthly reports showing sales, spend, return and your best products, plus updates whenever something important changes.

#### Can you fix my existing Shopping account?

Yes. I audit your Merchant Center and campaigns, fix the feed and rebuild the structure so your Shopping Ads become profitable again.

#### How do I get started?

Just book a free Google Shopping audit using the button on this page. I will review your store and feed and show you how we can grow your sales.

The basics

### What link building is and why it matters

Link building is the work of getting other websites to link to yours. Each quality link acts like a vote of trust that tells Google your site is a reliable source worth ranking.

This matters because backlinks remain one of the top ways Google decides who ranks. If your competitors have stronger links, they often outrank you even with similar content. Good link building closes that gap.

- Real links from trusted, relevant sites
- White hat methods only
- Every new link tracked and reported
Book your free backlink audit

Votes of trust Example

Same kind of content. Trusted sites that link to it:

- Industry news site No link
- Trade association No link
- Relevant blog Links here
- Partner website No link

Fewer votes of trust, so Google has less reason to put you first.

Why it works

### Why backlinks are so powerful for rankings

Links are still one of the clearest signals Google uses to decide who deserves the top spots.

#### Links are a top ranking signal

Google treats links as votes of trust. Quality links to your pages are one of the clearest ways to lift your rankings.

#### They build authority and trust

Links from respected sites raise your whole site's authority, which helps all your pages rank better, not just the linked one.

#### They bring referral traffic

A good link on a relevant site also sends real visitors to you, so you get customers as well as ranking power.

#### They help you beat competitors

Often the only thing between you and the top spot is a stronger link profile. Closing that gap is how you overtake them.

What I do

Every link is earned on a real, relevant site. Pick one to see what the work looks like.

Backlink audit. I review your current links to see what is helping, what is missing and whether any harmful links need to be dealt with.

The right way

### Why I only build safe, white hat links

There are two kinds of link building. The wrong kind uses cheap, spammy links that can boost you for a while and then get you penalized, sometimes wiping out your rankings overnight.

I only use white hat methods, which means real links from real, relevant websites. This approach is slower than buying bulk links, but it is safe and it lasts. I will never put your site at risk for a quick result.

The real rule

### Why quality beats quantity every time

Many people ask how many links they can get. That is the wrong question. One strong link from a trusted, relevant site is worth more than a hundred weak ones.

So I focus on relevance and quality, not big numbers. A smaller set of powerful, relevant links will lift your rankings far more safely than a pile of low value ones ever could.

- Relevance to your business first
- Trusted sites with real traffic
- Links placed inside useful content

Common questions

### Link building questions, answered

Safety, quality, timelines and reporting. If yours is not here, ask me on the call.

#### What is link building?

Link building is the work of getting other websites to link to yours. Each quality link acts as a vote of trust that helps Google rank your site higher.

#### Why do backlinks matter for SEO?

Backlinks are one of Google's top ranking signals. Quality links raise your site's authority and help your pages rank, often more than any other single factor.

#### Are all backlinks good?

No. Links from trusted, relevant sites help you, but spammy or unrelated links can hurt your rankings. Quality and relevance matter far more than quantity.

#### What is a white hat link?

A white hat link is one earned through safe, honest methods on a real, relevant website. These links are safe from penalties and they last, unlike cheap spammy links.

#### What is guest posting?

Guest posting is writing a quality article for another relevant website, which includes a link back to your site. It builds authority and can bring referral traffic too.

#### How many links do I need?

There is no magic number. One strong, relevant link is worth more than a hundred weak ones. I focus on quality and relevance, not big counts.

#### How do you find link opportunities?

I study your competitors' links, your industry and trusted relevant sites to find the best places to earn links that will actually lift your rankings.

#### Are the links permanent?

I aim for links that are placed to last on real, established sites. No one can promise a link stays forever, but quality placements are far more stable than cheap ones.

#### Can bad links hurt my site?

Yes. Spammy or unnatural links can lower your rankings or trigger a penalty. This is exactly why I only use safe white hat methods.

#### What is a disavow?

A disavow tells Google to ignore certain harmful links pointing at your site. If toxic links are hurting you, I identify them and help remove or disavow them.

#### How soon will I see results?

Link building is a longer term investment. You usually see rankings improve over a couple of months as the new links gain value and trust.

#### Do you guarantee rankings?

No honest SEO can guarantee exact rankings, because Google alone decides. What I promise is safe, quality links and steady, real improvement over time.

#### How do you measure link quality?

I look at the trust and authority of the site, how relevant it is to you, its real traffic and where the link sits. Relevance and trust matter most.

#### Can you remove toxic links?

Yes. I audit your link profile, find harmful links and help remove or disavow them so they stop dragging your rankings down.

#### What reports will I get?

You get clear reports showing the new links built, your authority and your rankings, plus updates on the progress in plain language.

#### How do I get started?

Just book a free backlink audit using the button on this page. I will review your link profile and show you how to grow your authority safely.

### Ready to build real authority?

Let us review your backlinks together and build a safe, quality link plan that lifts your rankings and closes the gap on your competitors.
Book your free backlink audit
No obligation · Free backlink audit

Common questions

### LinkedIn Ads questions, answered

Cost, targeting, lead quality and reporting. If yours is not here, ask me on the call.

#### What are LinkedIn Ads?

LinkedIn Ads are paid ads shown to professionals on LinkedIn. Because people share their real job details, you can target buyers by their role, company and industry, which is ideal for B2B.

#### Are LinkedIn Ads good for B2B?

Yes. LinkedIn is the best platform for B2B, because you can reach the exact decision makers who make buying choices, which you cannot do as precisely anywhere else.

#### Why are LinkedIn Ads more expensive than other platforms?

You are paying to reach high value professionals in a business setting. The cost per lead is higher, but the lead quality is often much higher too, so the return can still be strong.

#### How much budget do I need for LinkedIn Ads?

LinkedIn needs a higher budget than Facebook or Google to gather enough data. On our call I will give you an honest view of the budget you need to see real results.

#### What is a Lead Gen Form?

A Lead Gen Form is a LinkedIn ad form that fills in automatically with the person's professional details. It makes enquiring quick and easy, which brings you more leads.

#### Can you target specific job titles and companies?

Yes. I can target by job title, function, seniority, company, industry and company size, so your ads reach exactly the right people.

#### How soon will I see leads?

You can start getting leads in the first couple of weeks. Because B2B buying takes longer, I focus on lead quality and steady results rather than instant volume.

#### Are LinkedIn Ads good for small businesses?

They can be, if you sell to other businesses and your average deal is valuable. For low value or B2C products, other platforms are usually a better fit, and I will tell you honestly.

#### Do you create the ad creatives and copy?

Yes. I write the copy, craft the offer and guide the creatives so your ads speak clearly to busy professionals.

#### Can LinkedIn Ads help with hiring?

Yes. LinkedIn is excellent for reaching candidates with specific skills and roles, so it works well for recruitment and hiring campaigns.

#### What is Sponsored Content?

Sponsored Content is an ad that appears directly in the LinkedIn feed as a single image, video or carousel. It is the most common and flexible LinkedIn ad format.

#### How do you measure success on LinkedIn Ads?

I track leads, cost per lead and lead quality using conversion tracking, and I focus on the leads that actually turn into real business for you.

#### Can you run LinkedIn Ads for clients outside India?

Yes. I work with clients in the US, Canada and other countries and can target any professional audience you want to reach.

#### What reports will I get?

You get clear monthly reports in plain language showing spend, leads, cost per lead and results, plus updates on anything important.

Common questions

### Local SEO questions, answered

Profiles, reviews, rankings and reporting. If yours is not here, ask me on the call.

#### What is local SEO?

Local SEO is the work that helps your business show up when people search for a service near them. It focuses on Google Maps, the local pack and searches with near me in them.

#### How is local SEO different from normal SEO?

Normal SEO tries to rank a website across a wide area. Local SEO focuses on your city and nearby area, and it puts a big focus on your Google Business Profile, map rankings and reviews.

#### What is Google Business Profile?

Google Business Profile is the free listing that shows your business on Google Maps and in the local pack. Optimizing it is the most important part of local SEO.

#### How soon will I see results?

Local SEO often shows movement within a few weeks, especially after profile and citation work. Stronger, stable results usually build over two to three months.

#### What is the local pack?

The local pack is the group of top three businesses shown on the map at the top of local search results. It gets a large share of clicks and calls, so ranking there is very valuable.

#### What are citations and NAP?

Citations are mentions of your business on directories and other sites. NAP means your name, address and phone number. Keeping these the same everywhere builds trust with Google.

#### How important are reviews for local SEO?

Very important. Reviews build trust with customers and help your rankings. I set up a simple system to get more genuine reviews and to respond to them.

#### Can you rank me for near me searches?

Yes. Near me searches are a core part of local SEO. By optimizing your profile, website and listings for your area, I help you appear for these searches.

#### Do you work with multi location businesses?

Yes. I can manage local SEO for businesses with several branches, setting up and optimizing a profile and local pages for each location.

#### Do I need a website for local SEO?

A website helps a lot and is recommended, but even without one, a strong Google Business Profile can bring calls and visits. I will advise on the best path for your situation.

#### How do you track local rankings?

I track where you appear on the map for your key searches, along with calls and clicks from your profile, and I share this in clear reports.

#### Can local SEO help a service area business?

Yes. If you travel to customers rather than having a shopfront, I can set up your profile as a service area business and target the areas you cover.

#### What reports will I get?

You get clear monthly reports showing map rankings, calls, clicks and profile activity, plus updates on the work done.

#### Can you fix a suspended Google Business Profile?

In many cases yes. I review why the profile was suspended, fix the cause and guide the reinstatement process to get you back on the map.

#### Do you work with businesses outside India?

Yes. Local SEO is based on location, so I can help local businesses in the US, Canada and other places rank in their own city and area.

#### How do I get started?

Just book a free local SEO audit using the button on this page. I will review your local presence and show you how to get found by more nearby customers.

Ads + CRM

### Meta Ads only works properly when your CRM is connected

Meta Ads learns from whatever you tell it a conversion is. If the only signal is a form fill, it goes and finds you more form fills, including the fake numbers and the people who were only browsing.

So on every account we connect the ads to your CRM. Each lead is saved with where it came from, your sales team updates the lead status, and the qualified leads and sales flow back into Meta Ads as conversions, with their value. From then on the platform goes after buyers, not forms.

Common questions

### Meta Ads questions, answered

Budgets, the Meta Pixel, creatives and reporting. If yours is not here, ask me on the call.

#### What are Meta Ads?

Meta Ads are the paid ads that run on Facebook and Instagram. Both platforms share one ad system called Meta, so a single strategy can reach people across both.

#### What is the difference between boosting a post and running proper Meta Ads?

Boosting is a simple, limited option that mostly buys likes. Proper Meta Ads use full targeting, tracking and creative testing to bring real leads and sales. The results are very different.

#### How much budget do I need for Facebook and Instagram ads?

It depends on your goals and your industry. Some clients start small and scale up once we see profit. On our call I will suggest a realistic starting budget for your market.

#### How soon will I see results?

Meta Ads can start bringing leads within the first few days. The first two to four weeks are used to test and learn, so stable results usually build from the first month.

#### What is the Meta Pixel and why do I need it?

The Meta Pixel is a small piece of code on your website that tracks what visitors do. It lets Meta learn who your buyers are and lets you retarget people, which greatly improves your results.

#### Can Meta Ads work for ecommerce?

Yes, very well. I use catalog ads, retargeting and smart audiences to bring ready to buy shoppers to your products and track every sale.

#### Can Meta Ads get me leads for a service business?

Yes. Lead form ads and strong landing pages can bring a steady flow of enquiries for service businesses, often at a low cost per lead.

#### Do you create the images and videos?

I guide and direct your creatives and write the copy. I plan exactly what the images and videos should show, and I can work with your designer or with simple assets you already have.

#### What is retargeting on Meta?

Retargeting shows ads to people who already visited your site or engaged with your page but did not buy. It is one of the cheapest and most profitable types of Meta Ads.

#### Why did my previous Facebook ads not work?

Usually it is one of three reasons: weak creatives, wrong targeting or broken tracking. I check all three, fix the real problem and rebuild the account the right way.

#### Which is better for my business, Facebook or Instagram?

Most businesses do best using both, since they share one system. I let the data decide where your budget performs best, rather than guessing.

#### Do you write the ad copy?

Yes. I write clear, benefit driven copy and test different versions to find the ones that bring the most action.

#### How do you target the right audience?

I use interests, behaviour, location and lookalike audiences based on your best customers. Then I test and refine until we find the audiences that convert.

#### Can you run lead form ads?

Yes. Lead form ads collect contact details right inside Facebook and Instagram, which makes it easy for people to enquire and easy for you to follow up.

#### What reports do I get?

You get clear monthly reports in plain language showing spend, leads, sales and return, plus updates whenever something important changes.

On-page SEO is the work you do on your own pages to help them rank, such as the content, the titles, the headings, the images and the internal links. It tells Google exactly what your page is about and why it deserves to rank.

This matters because even a great page will struggle if Google cannot clearly understand it. Good on-page SEO connects your page to the searches your customers use, which lifts your rankings and your traffic.

- Every page matched to the right search
- Titles people want to click
- Content that fully answers the searcher

Why it works

### Why on-page SEO gives fast wins

It is the part of SEO you control completely, which is why it so often moves first.

#### It tells Google what your page is about

Clear titles, headings and content help Google match your page to the right searches. This is the base of every ranking.

#### You are in full control

Unlike links, which depend on others, on-page SEO is fully in your hands. That means faster changes and faster results.

#### It lifts rankings for your keywords

Tuning your pages for the right keywords and search intent often moves you up the results without needing anything else.

#### Better pages convert more

Good on-page work also improves the experience for visitors, so more of them turn into leads and sales.

The real key

### Why matching search intent beats stuffing keywords

Old SEO was about repeating a keyword many times. That does not work today and can even hurt you. What Google really wants is a page that fully answers what the searcher is looking for.

So when I optimize a page, I focus on search intent, which means understanding what the person actually wants and making sure your page gives it clearly. This is the difference between a page that ranks and one that gets ignored.

- What the searcher actually wants
- Answered clearly on the page
- Keywords used naturally, not stuffed

Common questions

### On-page SEO questions, answered

Titles, intent, content and reporting. If yours is not here, ask me on the call.

#### What is on-page SEO?

On-page SEO is the work done on your own pages to help them rank, such as the content, titles, headings, images and internal links. It tells Google what your page is about.

#### What is the difference between on-page and off-page SEO?

On-page SEO is about your own pages and content. Off-page SEO is about signals from outside your site, mainly backlinks. Both are needed for strong rankings.

#### What is the difference between on-page and technical SEO?

On-page SEO focuses on content and page elements. Technical SEO focuses on the health of your site, like speed and indexing. They work together as a complete SEO plan.

#### What are title tags and meta descriptions?

The title tag is the clickable headline shown in search results, and the meta description is the short summary below it. Good ones include your keyword and encourage people to click.

#### How important are headings for SEO?

Very important. A clear H1 and H2 structure helps Google understand your page and helps readers follow it. Good headings often improve both rankings and time on page.

#### What is keyword mapping?

Keyword mapping means giving each page its own clear keyword and search intent, so your pages do not compete with each other and each one targets the right searches.

#### What is search intent?

Search intent is what the person really wants when they search. Matching your page to that intent is the most important part of ranking today, more than repeating keywords.

#### How does internal linking help?

Internal links connect your pages and pass authority between them. They help Google find your important pages and can lift the rankings of the pages you link to.

#### Do you rewrite my content?

I improve and expand your content where needed so it fully answers the searcher and includes the right keywords naturally. I keep your voice and message intact.

#### How soon will I see results?

On-page changes often show movement within a few weeks, which makes it one of the faster parts of SEO. Bigger gains build over a couple of months.

#### What is image alt text?

Alt text is a short description of an image that helps Google understand it and helps accessibility. It is a small but useful on-page ranking signal.

#### Do you add schema markup?

Yes. I add structured data so Google understands your pages better and can show rich results, which also helps your content appear in AI answers.

#### How is on-page SEO different from writing blogs?

Blogs are new content you create. On-page SEO is optimizing any page, new or old, so it ranks. I often improve your existing pages first, since that brings quick wins.

#### Can on-page SEO fix a page that dropped in rankings?

Often yes. A page can drop when its content no longer matches what searchers want. I refresh and re-optimize it to win back its position.

#### What reports will I get?

You get clear reports showing rankings, traffic and the on-page work done, in plain language, plus updates on progress.

#### How do I get started?

Just book a free on-page SEO audit using the button on this page. I will review your key pages and show you how to help them rank.

### Ready to get your pages ranking?

Let us look at your key pages together and build a plan to lift them up the results and bring you more traffic.

The basics

### What performance marketing really means

Performance marketing is a type of paid advertising where you only invest in actions that matter to your business. Instead of paying for a vague idea of brand awareness, you pay for measurable results such as clicks, leads, calls, sign ups and sales. Every part of the campaign is tracked, so you always know what you are getting for your money.

This is very different from old school advertising where you spend a big amount and simply hope it works. With performance marketing, I can see which ad, which keyword and which audience brought you a sale. Then I put more budget behind what works and cut what does not. That is how your results keep getting better month after month.

- Pay for clicks, leads, calls, sign ups and sales
- Every ad, keyword and audience tracked
- More budget behind what works, less behind what does not

Common questions

### Performance marketing questions, answered

Budgets, platforms, tracking and fees. If yours is not here, ask me on the call.

#### What is performance marketing?

Performance marketing is paid advertising where you invest in real results such as leads, calls and sales, not just views or clicks. Every part of the campaign is tracked, so you can clearly see the return you are getting on your money.

#### How is performance marketing different from normal digital marketing?

Normal marketing often focuses on awareness and reach. Performance marketing focuses on measurable actions that grow your revenue. In simple words, you pay for outcomes, and every rupee is tracked back to a result.

#### Which platforms do you run performance marketing campaigns on?

I run campaigns on Google Ads, Meta Ads on Facebook and Instagram, LinkedIn Ads, YouTube Ads, Amazon Ads and Google Shopping. I choose the right mix based on your goals, your customers and your budget.

#### How much budget do I need to start?

There is no single answer, because it depends on your industry and your goals. Some clients start small and scale up once we see profit. On our first call, I will suggest a realistic starting budget for your market so you never overspend.

#### How soon will I see results?

Paid ads can start bringing traffic and leads within the first few days. That said, the first two to four weeks are used to gather data and improve the account. Real, stable results usually build from the first month onwards.

#### Do you only care about clicks or actual sales?

I care about sales and leads, not just clicks. Clicks are only the first step. My job is to turn those clicks into real customers and to lower your cost per result over time.

#### What is return on ad spend and why does it matter?

Return on ad spend, or ROAS, tells you how much revenue you earn for every rupee spent on ads. For example, a ROAS of five means you earned five rupees for every one rupee spent. It is one of the clearest ways to measure if your ads are profitable.

#### Can you fix my current ads that are not working?

Yes. This is one of the most common requests I get. I will audit your account, find the leaks that are wasting money, and rebuild the parts that are holding you back. Often the tracking itself is broken, which I fix first.

#### Do you work with small businesses or only big brands?

I work with both. Small and local businesses are welcome, and paid ads can work very well for them when set up carefully. I shape the plan around your size and your budget.

#### Will you handle both the strategy and the ad creatives?

Yes. I plan the full strategy, write the ad copy and guide the creatives so your images and videos match the message. You get a complete service, not just campaign settings.

#### How do you track leads and sales from my campaigns?

I set up proper conversion tracking using tools like Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4 and the Meta Pixel. This connects every form, call and purchase back to the ad that caused it, so we always know what is really working.

#### Do you provide reports and how often?

Yes. You get clear monthly reports written in plain language, plus updates whenever something important changes. You will always understand what you spent and what you earned back.

#### Can you run ads for my ecommerce store?

Yes. Ecommerce is a great fit for performance marketing. I use Google Shopping, Performance Max, Meta Ads and Amazon Ads to bring ready to buy shoppers to your products and track every sale.

#### Do you charge a fixed fee or a percentage of ad spend?

It depends on the size and needs of your account. I will explain the options clearly on our call and pick the one that is fair for both of us. There are no hidden charges.

#### Is performance marketing better than SEO?

They do different jobs. Paid ads bring fast results and instant traffic, while SEO builds free long term traffic over time. The best growth usually comes from using both together, and I can guide you on the right balance.

#### Do I need a landing page for my paid ads?

In most cases, yes. A focused landing page converts far better than a normal website page. If your landing page is weak, I will point it out and help you improve it, because it directly affects your cost per lead.

#### Can you run campaigns for clients outside India?

Yes. I work with clients in the US, Canada and other countries. Paid ad platforms are global, so I can manage your account from anywhere and target any market you want to reach.

#### What makes you different from a big agency?

With me, you work directly with the person who builds and runs your ads. There is no junior team and no middleman. You get faster replies, honest reporting and more of your budget going into actual results.

Just book a free strategy call using the button on this page. We will talk about your business and your goals, and I will show you how paid ads can grow your leads and sales. No pressure at all.

## Technical SEO services that fix what is holding your rankings back

Technical SEO is the foundation that all your other SEO work sits on. If the foundation is broken, even great content and links will struggle. We help businesses of all sizes build a fast, clean and search friendly website.

The basics

### What technical SEO is and why it matters

Technical SEO is the work that helps search engines crawl your site, understand your pages and rank them without any blocks. It covers things like site speed, mobile friendliness, site structure, indexing and code level details.

This matters because Google cannot rank what it cannot properly reach or understand. Fixing technical issues often unlocks rankings that your content already deserves but was not getting.

- Google can reach every important page
- Pages stored and ready to show in search
- A fast, clean site for people and Google
Book your free technical SEO audit

How Google reaches your page Example

One important page, three steps

- 1. Crawl Google reads the page Reached
- 2. Index A stray noindex tag blocks it Blocked
- 3. Rank The page never shows in search Not shown

Great content, but Google cannot store the page, so it cannot rank.

Why it works

### Why technical SEO is so important

Everything else in SEO sits on top of a healthy site. When the base is right, the rest pays off.

#### No rankings without crawling and indexing

If Google cannot crawl and index your pages, they simply will not show in search. Fixing this is the first step to any rankings at all.

#### Speed affects rankings and sales

A slow site loses both rankings and customers. Faster pages rank better and keep more visitors, which means more leads and sales.

#### Mobile first is the standard

Google mainly looks at the mobile version of your site. If your site works poorly on phones, your rankings suffer everywhere.

#### It powers all your other SEO

Content and links work far better on a clean, fast site. Technical SEO is the base that makes everything else pay off.

What I fix

### The technical issues I check and fix

The speed factor

### Why Core Web Vitals and speed matter so much

Core Web Vitals are Google's way of measuring how fast and stable your pages feel to a real user. They look at how quickly your page loads, how fast it responds and whether things jump around while loading.

A slow, jumpy site frustrates visitors and loses rankings and sales. I improve these scores by fixing heavy images, slow code and other issues, which makes your site faster for people and stronger in search.

- Heavy images made lighter
- Slow code cleaned up
- Layout that stays still while loading

Common questions

### Technical SEO questions, answered

Audits, speed, indexing and reporting. If yours is not here, ask me on the call.

#### What is technical SEO?

Technical SEO is the work that helps search engines crawl, understand and rank your website. It covers things like site speed, mobile friendliness, indexing, site structure and code level details.

#### How is technical SEO different from on-page SEO?

On-page SEO is about your content, keywords and page structure. Technical SEO is about the health of your site itself, making sure Google can reach and read it. Both are needed to rank well.

#### What is a technical SEO audit?

A technical SEO audit is a deep check of your website to find every issue affecting your crawling, indexing, speed and rankings. It gives a clear picture of what is holding your site back.

#### What are Core Web Vitals?

Core Web Vitals are Google's scores for how fast and stable your pages feel to a real user. They look at load speed, response time and layout stability, and they affect your rankings.

#### Why is my site not ranking even with good content?

Often a hidden technical issue is the cause, like slow speed, crawl problems or indexing errors. Good content cannot rank if Google cannot properly reach or understand it.

#### How does site speed affect SEO?

A slow site loses rankings and visitors. Google prefers fast pages, and users leave slow ones, so improving speed helps both your rankings and your sales.

#### What are crawling and indexing?

Crawling is when Google reads your pages, and indexing is when it stores them to show in search. If either fails, your pages will not appear in results at all.

#### What is schema markup?

Schema markup is special code that helps Google understand your pages better. It can lead to rich results in search and also helps your content show up in AI answers.

#### Do you fix the issues or just find them?

I fix them. Many services only hand you a report. I go further and make the actual changes, so your site really improves.

#### How long does a technical audit take?

A full audit usually takes a few days, depending on the size of your site. I then share the findings and a clear plan sorted by priority.

#### What tools do you use?

I use trusted tools like Google Search Console, PageSpeed Insights and professional crawlers to find issues, but the real value is in knowing which fixes actually move rankings.

#### Can technical SEO help my ecommerce store?

Yes, a lot. Large stores often have crawl, speed and duplicate content issues. Fixing these can unlock rankings and sales across many product pages at once.

#### Do I need technical SEO if my site is small?

Even small sites can have speed, mobile or indexing issues that quietly hurt rankings. A quick audit will show whether it is worth the effort for your site.

#### Will you break my site while fixing it?

No. I work carefully and test every change. My goal is to improve your site safely, and I always check that everything still works after each fix.

#### What reports will I get?

You get a clear audit report and simple updates showing what was fixed and the impact, all in plain language.

#### How do I get started?

Just book a free technical SEO audit using the button on this page. I will check your site and show you exactly what is holding your rankings back.

### Ready to fix your website and climb the rankings?

Let me run a technical check on your site and build a clear plan to fix what is holding you back. The first step is a simple, friendly call.
Book your free technical SEO audit

#### What are YouTube Ads?

YouTube Ads are video and image ads that run on YouTube. They are managed through Google Ads, so they come with strong targeting and full tracking.

#### Do I need a professional video?

#### How am I charged, per view or per click?

It depends on the format. With skippable ads you usually pay only when someone watches a good part of your ad or clicks, which keeps your money focused on real interest.

#### What is a skippable in stream ad?

It is an ad that plays before or during a video and can be skipped after a few seconds. You mostly pay only when someone keeps watching, so it is very cost effective.

#### What are bumper ads?

Bumper ads are six second ads that cannot be skipped. They are great for quick, memorable messages that keep your brand in people's minds.

#### Can YouTube Ads get me sales or only views?

They can get you sales when set up with proper tracking and remarketing. Views are only the start, and my job is to turn attention into real customers.

I use interests, topics, keywords, placements, custom audiences and remarketing, so your ads reach people who are likely to care about your offer.

#### Can I retarget people who visited my site?

Yes. Remarketing on YouTube shows your ads to people who already visited your website, which is one of the cheapest ways to bring back lost buyers.

Awareness and views build quickly, often within days. Leads and sales usually build over the first few weeks as we test and improve the account.

The basics

### What a CRM does and why you need one

A CRM, or customer relationship management system, is one place to store all your leads and customers, track every conversation and manage your sales from first contact to closed deal.

Without one, leads get lost, follow ups are forgotten and you never really know what is happening in your pipeline. Zoho CRM fixes this by keeping everything organized in one place, so your team always knows who to contact and when, and no opportunity slips away.

- Every lead and customer in one place
- Every conversation tracked
- A clear pipeline from first contact to closed deal

Zoho CRM gives small and growing businesses serious features without a huge cost. Here is why it is a strong fit.

#### Part of a full ecosystem

#### Flexible and customizable

Zoho can be shaped around your exact sales process, fields and stages, rather than forcing you to change how you work.

#### Built in automation

Zoho can automate follow ups, reminders and tasks, so your team spends less time on admin and more time selling.

The real value

### Why a good setup means no lead falls through

The biggest leak in most businesses is not lead generation, it is follow up. Leads come in and then get forgotten, and those lost follow ups are lost sales.

A properly set up Zoho CRM closes that leak. Every lead is captured, assigned and followed up automatically, with reminders so nothing slips. This single change often brings more sales from the leads you already have, without spending a rupee more on marketing. That is the real value of doing the setup right.

Follow up leak check Self check

Ads + CRM

### Your ads only work properly when your CRM is connected

Google Ads learns from whatever you tell it a conversion is. If the only signal is a form fill, it goes and finds you more form fills, including the fake numbers and the people who were only browsing.

Your Zoho CRM is the one place that knows which leads were real. So when we set it up, the ad click is saved with every lead, your team updates the lead status as they work it, and Zoho sends the qualified leads and sales back to Google Ads as conversions, with their value. From then on your ads go after buyers, not forms.

- Ad click saved with every lead in Zoho
- Lead status kept up to date by your sales team
- Qualified leads and sales sent back to Google Ads
- Reports on cost per qualified lead and cost per sale

- Zoho CRM
- HubSpot CRM
- GoHighLevel

Four leads from this week's ads

- Lead 1 Fake number Not counted
- Lead 2 Just browsing Not counted
- Lead 3 Qualified Sent to Google Ads
- Lead 4 Paid Sent with sale value

Google Ads sees the 2 leads that mattered, so it goes after more people like your real customers.

Common questions

### Frequently asked questions about Zoho CRM

Setup, cost, data, automation and training. If yours is not here, ask me on the call.

#### What is Zoho CRM?

Zoho CRM is a system that keeps all your leads and customers in one place, tracks every conversation and helps you manage sales from first contact to closed deal.

#### Why do I need a CRM?

Without a CRM, leads get lost and follow ups are forgotten, which means lost sales. A CRM keeps everything organized so nothing slips and you close more deals.

#### Is Zoho CRM good for small business?

Yes. Zoho CRM is powerful but affordable, which makes it a great fit for small and growing businesses that want serious features without a huge cost.

#### Can you set it up for me?

Yes. I handle the full setup, from configuration and pipelines to automation and training, so you get a working CRM without the headache of doing it yourself.

#### Can you customize the pipelines and fields?

Yes. I shape your pipeline, stages and fields around how you actually sell, so the CRM matches your real process instead of forcing you to change.

#### Can you connect my website and ad leads?

Yes. I connect your website forms, ads and other sources so new leads flow straight into your CRM automatically, with no manual entry.

#### Can you automate follow ups?

Yes. I set up automation for follow ups, reminders and tasks, so leads are always contacted on time and nothing is forgotten.

#### Can you migrate my data from spreadsheets or another CRM?

Yes. I move your existing leads and contacts into Zoho cleanly and safely, so you start with all your data in one place.

#### Will you train my team?

Yes. I train your team so they actually use the CRM properly, because a CRM only delivers results when people use it.

#### How long does the setup take?

It depends on how complex your process is, but most setups take from a few days to a couple of weeks. I will give you a clear timeline after our first talk.

#### Is Zoho CRM affordable?

Yes. Zoho is known for offering strong features at a reasonable price, and I will help you choose the right plan for your needs.

#### Can it send emails automatically?

Yes. I connect your email and can set up automated emails and sequences, so leads get timely, consistent follow up without manual effort.

#### Can you build reports and dashboards?

Yes. I build clear reports and dashboards so you can see your pipeline, sales and team performance at a glance.

#### Do you provide ongoing support?

Yes. I stay available after setup to help with changes, questions and improvements, so your CRM keeps working as your business grows.

#### Is my data safe in Zoho CRM?

Zoho follows strong security practices to protect your data. I also set up your account correctly with the right access controls for your team.

#### How do I get started?

Just book a free Zoho CRM consultation using the button on this page. I will learn how you work and show you how a proper setup can grow your sales.

# OurKnots Meta Ads Case Study: 5.13x ROAS | Sushant Rana

URL: https://sushantrana.com/case-studies/ourknots/

How OurKnots grew from its first order in Nov 2024 to ₹3.84L of store sales in Sep 2026, as Meta ROAS rose from 0.72x to 5.13x. Real data and screenshots.

- Home
- Meta Ads
- OurKnots

Case study · Meta Ads

## OurKnots on Meta: from 0.72x to 5.13x ROAS

OurKnots sells fabric laces, borders and trims through its Shopify store, which took its first order in November 2024. In February 2025 its Meta Ads spent ₹32.7K to bring back ₹23.4K. My team and I rebuilt the account month by month, and in September 2026 the store did ₹3.84 lakh from 152 orders, with Meta reporting a 5.13x ROAS.

Sales come from Shopify, ad numbers from Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads, and the campaigns are still running. Hover the chart to follow the journey month by month.

The real struggle

### A year of thin, unstable returns

This did not start as a success story. For most of 2025 the account spent money without a clear engine behind it.

Catalogue, engagement and messenger campaigns brought reach and chats but very few purchases. Sale pushes for Holi, summer and June worked for a month and faded the next. Even when spend rose to ₹60K a month in September 2025, every rupee returned only about ₹1.80.

- Feb 2025: ₹32.7K spent for 12 purchases, a 0.72x ROAS
- Feb 2025: a ₹32K budget split across eight campaigns at once
- Jun 2025 hit 3.02x, then July fell back to 1.57x
- Jan 2026: a post festive dip to 1.75x

Then and now From Meta Ads Manager

| Month | Feb 2025 | Sep 2026

| Ad spend | ₹32.7K | ₹70.6K

| Purchases | 12 | 118

| Revenue from Meta | ₹23.4K | ₹3.62L

| ROAS | 0.72x | 5.13x

| Cost per purchase | ₹2.7K | ₹598

A little over twice the spend, almost ten times the purchases and over fifteen times the revenue.

Meta, Google and the store

### Why we judge on Shopify, not the ad platforms

Add up what Meta and Google each report for September 2026 and you get more than the store actually sold. That is normal: a shopper who clicked a Meta ad and a Google ad before buying is counted by both.

So the account is judged on Shopify: everything the store sold, divided by everything spent on ads. In September 2026 that blended number was 4.82x.

- Meta and Google numbers overlap
- Shopify is the single source of truth
- Budget moves on blended ROAS, not platform ROAS

September 2026, three views Real numbers

- Shopify, what the store sold 152 orders ₹3.84L
- Meta reports 118 purchases ₹3.62L
- Google Ads reports, about 43.91 conversions ₹1.27L
- Blended ROAS Store sales ÷ ₹79.7K of ad spend 4.82x

What we changed

### Four changes that turned the account around

No single trick. A simpler account, better creative and decisions made on real revenue.

#### Fewer, stronger campaigns

In early 2025 a small budget was split across up to eight campaigns at once. Today four sale campaigns and one awareness campaign carry the spend, so Meta can actually learn.

#### Creative as the main lever

A steady rhythm of new offer angles, formats and hooks, with tired creative retired before it can push the cost per purchase up.

#### A cheap awareness layer

Around ₹3K a month of video awareness reaches over a million people and keeps retargeting audiences full of warm shoppers.

#### Decisions on real revenue

Meta's numbers are checked against Shopify every day, so budget follows money in the bank, not platform reported results alone.

Milestones

### From one order to ₹3.84 lakh a month

Not a straight line. These are the months that mattered.

- 01 Nov 2024 The first order The Shopify store took its very first order. December brought 8 more.
- 02 Feb 2025 The low point ₹32.7K spent across catalogue, engagement and messenger campaigns for 12 purchases worth ₹23.4K: a 0.72x ROAS.
- 03 Jun 2025 The first 3x month One focused sale campaign did ₹76.4K from ₹25.3K of spend, a 3.02x ROAS. July slipped back to 1.57x.
- 04 Sep 2025 Meta crosses ₹1 lakh in a month 72 purchases worth ₹1.09L, still at a thin 1.80x ROAS as spend climbed to ₹60.3K.
- 05 Oct 2025 The store crosses ₹1 lakh in a month 126 orders and ₹1.54 lakh of total sales in the Diwali month, the store's first ₹1 lakh month.
- 06 Jan 2026 ₹1 lakh plus, every month From January 2026 the store has crossed ₹1 lakh of sales every single month, and Meta alone has reported over ₹1.28 lakh a month since February.
- 07 Jul 2026 100+ purchases in a month 116 purchases worth ₹2.79L on ₹88.3K of spend.
- 08 Sep 2026 The record month 152 orders and ₹3.84 lakh of store sales. Meta reported 118 purchases worth ₹3.62L at 5.13x, and the best sale campaign returned 9.94x.

Sep 2026. Spend ₹70.6K · 118 purchases · ₹3.62L revenue · ROAS 5.13x

The method

### How we lift ROAS in the first 60 days

The same playbook we would run on a new account. The aim of the first 60 days is not a spike, it is a stable, scalable ROAS floor to push budget into.

Step 01

#### Audit and clean base

A full account, pixel, Conversions API and event quality audit. Tracking gaps are fixed first, redundant campaigns are cut, and a daily Shopify versus Meta tracker is set up.

- Pixel and CAPI audit
- Campaigns consolidated
- Daily revenue tracker

Step 02

#### Establish the ROAS floor

A lean prospecting and retargeting structure with three to five tested creative angles, left to exit the learning phase cleanly.

- Lean structure
- 3 to 5 creative angles
- Winning offer found

Step 03

#### Compound the winners

Double down on winning creative and audiences, retire tired ads before costs drift up, and add bundles or threshold offers to raise revenue per order.

- Winners scaled
- Fatigue caught early
- AOV levers added

Step 04

#### Scale without breaking

Budget rises in controlled steps on proven campaigns, watching frequency and marginal ROAS, with an always on creative pipeline behind it.

- Controlled budget steps
- Marginal ROAS watched
- Documented structure

What moved the needle

### What made the difference in September 2026

The record month, campaign by campaign.

#### One ABO sale campaign at 9.94x

₹89.1K of purchases from ₹8,965 of spend, the controllable sale campaign that came out of consolidating the old sprawl.

#### The workhorse at 5.52x

The core sale campaign drove 44 purchases worth ₹1.32 lakh from ₹24K of spend.

#### Awareness for ₹3K

The video awareness campaign reached 1.08 million people for about ₹3K, keeping retargeting full and prospecting cheap.

How we work with you

### Your account, your money, full visibility

100% of advertising spend is billed directly to your own Meta Ads account. Campaigns run inside your Meta Business Manager, Meta charges your payment method directly, and media spend is never routed, marked up or resold. Our fee is separate from media.

- Account ownership: always yours
- Media billing: direct to your Meta account
- Reporting: weekly and monthly, reconciled to revenue

- Tracking: pixel and CAPI, audited
- First 60 days: stabilise, then scale

Common questions

### OurKnots on Meta Ads, answered

#### What ROAS does OurKnots get from Meta Ads?

Meta reported a 5.13x ROAS in September 2026, up from 0.72x in February 2025.

#### How much does the OurKnots store sell in a month?

₹3.84 lakh of store sales from 152 orders in September 2026, its record month. The store has crossed ₹1 lakh of sales every month since January 2026.

#### Why is blended ROAS different from Meta ROAS?

Meta and Google both take credit for some of the same orders, so their numbers overlap. The account is judged on Shopify: everything the store sold divided by everything spent on ads, which was 4.82x in September 2026.

The real struggle

### A good first month, then a crash

January looked promising at 5.33x. February did not: spend went up to ₹12K and conversions fell to 6, each costing ₹2,000.

March recovered only to 2.13x, and June slipped back to 2.88x. The turnaround came from making the same budget work harder, not from spending more.

- Feb 2026: 0.71x ROAS, ₹2,000 per conversion
- Mar 2026: 2.13x, ₹1,070 per conversion
- Jun 2026: a dip to 2.88x before the climb

| Cost per conversion | ₹2.00K | ₹206

| ROAS | 0.71x | 14.05x

Less spend than February, seven times the conversions, and every conversion about ten times cheaper.

- 03 Apr 2026 Back above 3x 18.12 conversions at ₹495 each and a 3.82x ROAS, on a smaller ₹8.96K budget.
- 04 Jul 2026 25 conversions in a month 25.01 conversions at ₹360 each, a 6.43x ROAS.
- 05 Aug 2026 Past 10x 33.11 conversions at ₹275 each and a 11.97x ROAS.
- 06 Sep 2026 The record month 43.91 conversions at ₹206 each and a 14.05x ROAS, on ₹9.05K of spend.

The challenge

### More renovation leads, without hiding the cost

Renovation leads are expensive, and volume the sales team cannot close is wasted money. Yalla Renovation needed steady enquiries across five services: homes, villas, apartments, kitchens and bathrooms.

Over these 24 months the account reached far more people and recorded far more conversions than in the 24 months before. Spend grew faster than conversions, so each one cost more. Both are on this page.

- Impressions up 1,298%
- Recorded conversions up 244%
- Cost per conversion up 22%, from AED 342 to AED 418

Against the 24 months before Google Ads compare

| Impressions | +1,298%

| Recorded conversions | +244%

| Ad spend | +321%

| Cost per conversion | AED 342 to AED 418

Reach and conversions grew much faster than they had before, and spend grew faster still. Each conversion cost about 22% more. This is a story about scale, and we show the cost of it.

The setup

### How the account is built

Search catches people already looking. Performance Max finds more of them. Each service gets its own campaign, so budgets follow what works.

#### Search by service

Separate Search campaigns for home, bathroom, kitchen, apartment and villa renovation, plus the brand name.

#### Performance Max

Home, bathroom and kitchen Performance Max campaigns reach people across Google beyond the search results.

#### Store visits

A Performance Max campaign for store visits, added in 2026 and measured apart from form leads.

#### Conversion tracking

Lead form submissions are tracked as their own conversion, apart from store visits and WhatsApp clicks.

The hero campaign

### One campaign, two thirds of the forms

Home Renovation on Performance Max brought 1,537.49 form submissions and 1,721.49 recorded conversions at AED 221.82 each.

That is 67.2% of all form submissions in the account, on 32.8% of the spend. Pick another campaign to compare.

- 1,537.49 form submissions
- AED 221.82 per recorded conversion
- 67.2% of forms on 32.8% of spend

Devices and networks

### Where the conversions actually came from

Spend, clicks and conversions do not line up neatly by device or network, and that is where the next savings are.

Switch between devices and networks to see each share.

- Mobile: 73.5% of clicks, 67.6% of conversions
- Computers: 15.2% of clicks, 31.7% of conversions
- Tablets: 11.3% of clicks, 0.7% of conversions

Where the results came from Share of total

Mobile brings most of the clicks and conversions. Computers bring 15% of clicks but 32% of conversions. Tablets bring 11% of clicks and almost no conversions, so they are next to check.

Search insights

### What people searched, and what it cost

The most shown Search ad, in the Home Renovation Search campaign, had 304,659 impressions, 15,425 clicks and a 5.06% click-through rate.

Searches covered the brand name, kitchen, bathroom, apartment and villa renovation in Dubai, and renovation company and contractor terms. Some keywords bring forms cheaply; others are clicked just as often and bring very few.

- 5.06% CTR on the most shown ad
- 20.79% CTR on brand searches
- Broad terms like "renovation dubai" cost the most per form

Keywords: what each form cost Search

| Keyword | Spend | Forms | Per form

| home renovation | AED 53,862 | 121.83 | AED 442

| bathroom renovation ideas | AED 29,679 | 53.03 | AED 560

| home renovations contractor | AED 26,986 | 41.64 | AED 648

| house renovation | AED 39,194 | 18 | AED 2,177

| "renovation dubai" | AED 31,399 | 7 | AED 4,486

Similar click-through rates, very different costs per form. "Home renovation" brought 121.83 forms at about AED 442 each; "renovation dubai" brought 7 at about AED 4,486 each.

Milestones

### Twenty-four months, month by month

The good months and the expensive ones, as the account recorded them.

- 01 Oct 2024 The starting point 146 recorded conversions on AED 15.4K of spend.
- 02 Apr 2025 The first big month 294 conversions and 18.2K clicks, on AED 29.8K.
- 03 Jul - Sep 2025 Spend steps up Budgets moved to AED 45K-49K a month, with 114 to 165 conversions each month.
- 04 Mar 2026 Reach jumps 3.3M impressions and 52.8K clicks in a single month.
- 05 Apr 2026 The record month 326.06 recorded conversions on AED 91.7K, the most of any month.
- 06 Jun - Sep 2026 Holding at scale AED 70K-109K a month for 79 to 88 conversions a month. The next job is bringing that cost back down.

The challenge

### Steady student enquiries, at a cost that works

Study abroad is a crowded market in Dubai and across the UAE. Generic "study abroad" ads are expensive and pull in people who are not ready to apply.

4S Study Abroad needed enquiries it could plan around: steady volume for every intake and education expo, at a cost per enquiry a consultancy's margin can carry.

- Predictable volume for intakes and expos
- Students and parents, reached separately
- A cost per enquiry the business can live with

24 months at a glance UAE campaigns

| Ad spend | AED 66,496

| Direct enquiries (form leads + WhatsApp) | 7,514

| Cost per direct enquiry | AED 8.79

| Instant form leads | 5,372 at AED 10.41

| WhatsApp conversations | 2,142 at AED 4.74

| Event responses | 176 at AED 0.82

| Impressions | 3.78M

| People reached | 1,151,472

| Link clicks | 23,835

Meta Ads Manager, 14 Oct 2024 to 12 Oct 2026. Cost per direct enquiry uses the spend on form and WhatsApp campaigns. Form leads, WhatsApp conversations and event responses are counted separately.

What worked

### Four decisions behind the low cost per enquiry

Each one backed by a number from the account.

#### Germany first

Germany and Schengen intent instead of generic study abroad: AED 10.60 per lead at AED 19.4K of spend in the biggest campaign.

#### Two funnels

Instant forms and WhatsApp side by side. WhatsApp conversations came in at AED 4.74, about half the cost of a form lead.

#### Creative tested

Same offer, video against image: AED 11.26 against AED 25.38 per lead. Video won and kept the budget.

#### Events as demand

Expo RSVP campaigns at AED 0.82 per response on tiny budgets, filling education fairs without touching the lead budget.

How cheap is cheap

### About 87% below education benchmarks

Form leads averaged AED 10.41, about USD 2.83. Published Meta benchmarks for education are USD 21.31 (SuperAds) and USD 28.22 (WordStream, 2025).

All 13 UAE lead form campaigns came in under AED 25.38 a lead; 11 of them under AED 16.

- ~87% below the SuperAds education average
- ~90% below the WordStream education benchmark
- Even the most expensive campaign stayed 68% below the SuperAds average

Cost per lead vs published benchmarks USD

WordStream, Education & Instruction (2025) $28.22

SuperAds, education average $21.31

4S Study Abroad, form leads $2.83

AED converted at the pegged 1 AED = 0.27226 USD. Benchmarks are broad datasets, not UAE-only, so read them as a yardstick. Sources: WordStream, SuperAds.

Year on year

### Spend went down 20%. Unit costs went down with it.

The second year spent less and got more for each dirham: more WhatsApp campaigns, ABO structures that protected the proven audiences, and video instead of image creative.

- Cost per form lead: AED 11.27 to AED 9.26
- Cost per WhatsApp conversation: AED 7.27 to AED 4.18
- Five more campaigns with delivery

Year 1 vs year 2 UAE

| | Oct 24 - Oct 25 | Oct 25 - Oct 26 | Change

| Spend | AED 37,548 | AED 29,877 | -20%

| Campaigns with delivery | 11 | 16 | +45%

| Cost per form lead | AED 11.27 | AED 9.26 | -17.8%

| Cost per WhatsApp conversation | AED 7.27 | AED 4.18 | -42.5%

The campaigns

### Eight campaigns carried the account

Germany and Schengen campaigns did the heavy lifting, with a separate campaign for parents, who often make the decision.

- 1,831 leads from Study in Germany
- 1,306 WhatsApp conversations at AED 3.65
- Parents targeted on their own

The campaigns that carried it 24 months

| Campaign | Type | Results | Per result | Spend

| Study in Germany | Instant form | 1,831 leads | AED 10.60 | AED 19,400

| All UAE locations | Instant form | 1,082 leads | AED 6.89 | AED 7,453

| WhatsApp, Mar 2026 (ABO) | WhatsApp | 1,306 conversations | AED 3.65 | AED 4,764

| Germany, WhatsApp | WhatsApp | 836 conversations | AED 6.43 | AED 5,380

| Education expo, image | Instant form | 541 leads | AED 10.72 | AED 5,798

| Schengen, parents | Instant form | 390 leads | AED 12.50 | AED 4,874

| Study in Germany, tailored | Instant form | 311 leads | AED 15.40 | AED 4,789

| Instant form, Mar 2026 (ABO) | Instant form | 288 leads | AED 8.25 | AED 2,376

The two biggest form campaigns brought 2,913 leads, 54% of all form leads in the account.

Creative test

### Video beat image, 2.3 times over

In the Education Expo 2026 push the same offer ran as two video sets and one image set. The numbers settled it.

- Video: AED 11.26 and AED 10.63 per lead
- Image: AED 25.38 per lead
- 428 of 489 leads came from video

Same offer, three creative sets Education Expo 2026

- Video ads 244 leads AED 11.26 Per lead
- Video ads, second set 184 leads AED 10.63 Per lead
- Image ads 61 leads AED 25.38 Per lead

Image creative cost 2.3 times more per lead, so the budget moved to video and stayed there.

Milestones

### The months that shaped the account

The months that changed the account, straight from the monthly screenshots.

- 01 Oct 2024 A strong start 445 form leads in a month from the Study in Germany and education expo campaigns, at about AED 7.65 per lead.
- 02 Jul 2025 WhatsApp opens up The first WhatsApp conversation campaign for Germany: 47 conversations in its first month, 192 by December.
- 03 Feb 2026 The creative test 369 form leads in the Education Expo 2026 push, with video beating image at less than half the cost per lead.
- 04 Mar 2026 New ABO campaigns Separate WhatsApp and instant form campaigns on proven audiences, at AED 2.67 and AED 6.44 per result in their first month.
- 05 Apr - May 2026 About 15 a day 447 and 451 direct enquiries a month, about 15 a day, on about AED 2.3K a month.
- 06 Sep 2026 Cheapest yet 268 direct enquiries at about AED 4.90 each, on AED 1.3K of UAE spend.

Proof

### Every month, straight from Meta Ads Manager

The campaigns view for each month. Campaign names and the ad account are blurred; every number is as Meta reports it. Totals in the screenshots also include a few small test campaigns outside the UAE, which this page leaves out. Pick a month, then click the screenshot to open it full size.

[Image: 4S Study Abroad Meta Ads Manager campaigns view for Sep 2026, campaign names blurred]
Sep 2026. UAE spend AED 1,314.19 · 89 form leads · 179 WhatsApp conversations

What comes next

### Where the account goes from here

Meta does not know who enrolled. These are the next steps we recommend.

#### Close the loop

Feed CRM outcomes back, so campaigns are judged on applications and enrolments, not just enquiries.

#### Lookalikes of enrolled students

Build audiences from students who actually enrolled, not from everyone who filled a form.

#### Beyond Germany

Take what worked for Germany and Schengen to the next destinations.

Common questions

### Meta Ads for education, answered

#### How much does a study-abroad lead cost on Meta Ads in the UAE?

For 4S Study Abroad, instant form leads averaged AED 10.41 (about USD 2.83) over 24 months. Published education benchmarks are USD 21.31 (SuperAds) and USD 28.22 (WordStream, 2025).

#### Do WhatsApp campaigns work better than lead forms for education?

In this account WhatsApp conversations cost AED 4.74 against AED 10.41 for a form lead, about half. Counsellors also get a warmer start, because the student has already written to them.

#### How long before Meta Ads give steady enquiry volume?

Here the second year was cheaper than the first: cost per form lead fell 17.8% and cost per WhatsApp conversation 42.5%, on 20% less spend.

# 4S Study Abroad Google Ads Case Study | Sushant Rana

URL: https://sushantrana.com/case-studies/4s-study-abroad-google-ads/

4S Study Abroad on Google Ads, Apr 2020 to Dec 2024: 8,859 student enquiries at ₹278 each, and cost per enquiry cut 59.6% after a tough 2023.

Case study · Google Ads · Education

## 4S Study Abroad on Google Ads: 8,859 enquiries at ₹278

4S Study Abroad is an overseas education consultancy in Dubai, UAE, placing students in Canada, the UK, Germany, Australia and Europe. Over 19 quarters, ₹24.6 lakh of Google Ads brought 8,859 enquiries at ₹277.91 each.

It was not a straight line, and the bad year is on this page too. Every number comes from the Google Ads account.

Book your free strategy call See the five phases

The challenge

### A decision, not a purchase

Nobody buys a degree in one visit. A student fills in a form, a counsellor follows up, and the placement closes offline weeks or months later. The only thing Google Ads can count is the enquiry.

Demand is seasonal around the September and January intakes, every destination is its own auction, and big consultancy networks and universities bid on the same searches.

- Four destination markets to fill
- A cost per enquiry the counsellors can convert
- Through a pandemic and every change to Google's campaign types

Where the ceiling was Search impression share

12.13%

Share won

72.76%

Lost to Ad Rank

15.12%

Lost to budget

The ceiling on this account was never money. Three quarters of the available searches were lost to ad rank, and only 15% to budget.

Destination first

### One campaign set per destination

Instead of one catch-all campaign, each destination got its own campaigns, budgets and bids. Canada, Germany and the UK took 86.5% of spend and brought 91.3% of enquiries.

Germany was the efficiency winner, Canada the volume engine. Generic and university-specific campaigns were the leak: 6% of spend, 2.4% of enquiries, at ₹695 each.

- Germany: ₹234.01 per enquiry, 8.12% CTR
- Canada: 38% of enquiries at ₹267.15
- Generic terms: 2.5 times the average cost

Spend share and cost per enquiry, by destination 19 quarters

Germany 26.67% of spend · ₹234 per enquiry

United Kingdom 22.84% of spend · ₹298 per enquiry

Australia 5.21% of spend · ₹334 per enquiry

Europe, incl. medical 2.14% of spend · ₹342 per enquiry

Malaysia 0.12% of spend · ₹498 per enquiry

Generic and university-specific 6.03% of spend · ₹695 per enquiry

Destinations are grouped from campaign names, so read them as indicative.

Channels and devices

### Search did the work, mostly on phones

Search took 98.66% of spend and brought 98.7% of enquiries. The automated formats ran as small, controlled tests.

Switch between campaign types and devices to see each share.

- Smart: ₹165.93 per enquiry, the cheapest in the account
- Performance Max: 11 enquiries, no value signal to learn from
- Display: zero enquiries, so it was stopped

Spend 0.10%

Enquiries 0.00%

Search did the work. The one Smart campaign brought the cheapest enquiries in the account, 40% below average, on 0.7% of the budget. Performance Max and Display were tests that did not convert.

Five phases

### Nineteen quarters, five chapters

Not a straight line: a restart, a scale-up, a peak, a mistake and a rebuild. Pick a year.

Phase 1 · Q2 - Q4 2020

#### Restart and proof of concept

The account restarted in April 2020, when borders were shut and intakes were being deferred. Spend was raised step by step, from ₹19,854 in Q2 to ₹1,55,688 in Q4, and each step had to keep cost per enquiry in check.

It did better than that: cost per enquiry fell 45.8%, from ₹294.14 to ₹159.43, and conversion rate climbed from 18.80% to 33.14%, the highest of the whole period. Q3 2020 had a 10.07% CTR, also the best on record.

₹3.23L

Spend

1,719

Enquiries

₹187.94

Per enquiry

28.73%

Conversion rate

The recovery

### From the worst quarter to better than average

The like-for-like test: the same quarter, a year apart. More spend, but far more enquiries for it, and each one cost less than half as much.

- Enquiries up 303.4%
- Cost per enquiry down 59.6%
- Conversion rate back to 17.37%

Q4 2023 against Q4 2024 Same quarter, a year apart

| | Q4 2023 | Q4 2024 | Change

| Spend | ₹39,377 | ₹64,227 | +63.1%

| Clicks | 611 | 1,370 | +124.2%

| CTR | 4.88% | 6.67% | +36.7%

| Average CPC | ₹64.45 | ₹46.88 | −27.3%

| Enquiries | 59 | 238 | +303.4%

| Cost per enquiry | ₹667.41 | ₹269.86 | −59.6%

Four quarters after its worst result, the account was beating its own 19-quarter average of ₹277.91.

What the data proves

### Six lessons from nineteen quarters

What held true across the whole account, good years and bad.

#### Structure beat budget

The best quarter, Q3 2022, used 22.7% less money than the biggest-spending one and brought more enquiries at ₹157.84 each.

#### Concentration is correct

The top 10 campaigns took 84.6% of spend and returned 90% of enquiries. 31 of 76 campaigns were left switched off.

#### Mobile is the market

78.06% of spend, 78.83% of enquiries, and a cost per enquiry 4.3% below computers.

#### Relevance, not money

72.76% of searches lost to ad rank and only 15.12% to budget. More budget would not have fixed it.

#### Automation needs a signal

Smart brought the cheapest enquiries, ₹165.93. Performance Max, with no value data to learn from, cost ₹1,199.39 each.

#### Plan for seasons

Q3 is the strongest quarter for conversion (25.2% in 2020, 30.2% in 2022). Budgets that build into intakes beat flat monthly pacing.

How we count

### Where the numbers come from

Everything is read from the Google Ads account for 1 April 2020 to 31 December 2024, with paused and removed campaigns included. 2020 covers nine months only.

Enquiries are the Google Ads conversions column, mostly lead form submissions. Conversion value was only partly set up, so we do not quote revenue or ROAS. Destination groups come from campaign names.

Quarterly sums against account totals Reconciliation

| | Quarterly sum | Account total | Match

| Conversions | 8,859.00 | 8,859.00 | 100.00%

| Clicks | 50,521 | 50,571 | 99.90%

| Impressions | 9,60,425 | 9,62,447 | 99.79%

| Spend | ₹24,58,689 | ₹24,61,996 | 99.87%

Two campaigns share a name, so one drops out of the quarterly split: ₹3,307, or 0.13% of spend. Campaign, device and account totals match Google Ads exactly.

Common questions

### Google Ads for education, answered

#### What was the cost per lead for this education Google Ads account?

₹277.91 per enquiry across 19 quarters, improving to ₹269.86 in the final quarter, Q4 2024.

#### How many leads did the campaigns generate?

8,859 enquiries from 50,571 clicks, a 16.47% click-to-enquiry rate.

#### Which destination market performed best?

Germany, at ₹234.01 per enquiry with an 8.12% CTR, on the second-largest budget.

#### Does Google Ads work for study-abroad consultancies?

It did here, with the account split by destination and tuned for ad relevance rather than reach. Conversion rate peaked at 33.14% in Q4 2020.

#### What is the biggest mistake in education PPC?

Buying reach to fix a relevance problem. In 2023 this account had its highest quarterly impressions and, by the end of the year, its worst cost per enquiry.

#### OurKnots

In February 2026 Google Ads spent ₹12K for 6 conversions at ₹2,000 each. In September 2026 it brought 43.91 conversions at ₹206 each, a 14.05x ROAS on ₹9.05K.
